caption: Comment MATH and I'll send you the free $1K Math calculator. Where the numbers come from: link-in-bio benchmarks put taps at about 1 to 3% of profile visits, and only some viewers visit your profile, so well under 1% of views is normal. That's why a comment word that sends your link in a DM helps so much. For buying, Littledata's study of 421 Shopify stores found a median of 1.4% of visits ending in a sale, and Dynamic Yield's data from 400+ brands averages 2.66%, so 2.5% is a hopeful guess; plan with the lower number too. One more thing: Instagram counts replays as views, so views are always higher than the number of people.
